title: 第三十章 谁是凶手
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
侯紫抬起头，看着黑猫脸上那道被指甲划出来的旧疤，沉默了下，然后问了一句：“什么时候发现的？”

    “半个时辰前。几个从落雁坡采药回来的散修路过树林边，看见尸体趴在草丛里。脚筋被放断的位置已经泡白了。”

    崔成敏说道：“死在坊市外面，不触犯坊市内不准杀人的规矩。毕景元不会管，城主府更不会管。但张麻子是在元鸦手里被废了之后送回东城帮的，现在人死了，不管怎么说，雷鹏都得给个说法。”

    “走，去看看。”侯紫招呼了下沈君壁。

    刚推开炼器铺的门，巷口已经出现三个人。雷鹏走在前面，那两个在东城帮总舵跟侯紫交过手的护卫跟在后面。雷鹏看见侯紫出来，说了一句：“走，先去现场。”

    坊市外槐树林边，张麻子的尸体在那里，周边围着好些人，都是贫民窟的散修。老槐头也在，他笑了笑，和侯紫打了个招呼。

    侯紫靠过去，问了句：“老丈，今天这么清闲？”

    “看热闹啊，谁不喜欢啊。”老槐头说着，指了指张麻子，“你看这张麻子，每天在贫民窟作威作福，这么多被欺负的都巴不得他死呢，却绝对没人敢真的动手。”说着眼光偷瞄了下雷鹏。

    张麻子的尸体也没什么异样，丹田被废，脚筋被挑都是死前的痕迹，也无发黑中毒的迹象。

    雷鹏对侯紫说：“马公子，这里看不出什么，不如我们去关押张麻子的地方看看。”

    “好。”侯紫也不多话。

    张麻子被关押的地方是东城帮在贫民窟边上的一间旧仓库，以前老崔用来堆炼器废料的，后来东城帮征用了当禁闭室。仓库只有一扇铁门，高处有几个通风口，用砖块草草封着，砖缝之间的空隙能伸进一根手指。门外站着一个瘦小的看守，脸色发白，嘴唇哆嗦着，看见雷鹏走过来，两腿一软差点跪下去。

    “雷爷……我真不知道怎么回事……昨晚门锁得好好的，我就在门口坐着，一步没离开过。天亮了我开门想给张麻子送饭，里面空了！人没了！门锁还是好好的！”

    雷鹏没有骂他，也没有看他，只是走到铁门前，伸手摸了摸那把铜锁。锁是完好的，没有被撬过的痕迹。他低头看门框上的铁栓，也没有任何损坏。看守在门口坐了一整夜。人却凭空消失了，然后死在坊市外的树林里。
content_en:
Hou Zi raised his head and looked at the old scar scratched by the nails on the black cat's face. He was silent for a moment, and then asked: "When did you discover it?"

"Half an hour ago. A few casual cultivators who came back from gathering herbs at Luoyanpo passed by the woods and saw the body lying in the grass. The broken hamstrings were soaked white."

Cui Chengmin said: "Death outside Fang City does not violate the rules of Fang City that prohibit killing. Bi Jingyuan will not care about it, and the city lord's palace will not care about it. But Zhang Mazi was sent back to the Dongcheng Gang after being deposed in the hands of Yuan Ya. Now that the person is dead, no matter what, Lei Peng has to give an explanation."

"Let's go take a look." Hou Zi greeted Shen Junbi.

As soon as he opened the door of the weapon refining shop, three people appeared at the entrance of the alley.Lei Peng walked in front, followed by the two guards who had fought with Hou Zi at the head of the Dongcheng Gang.Lei Peng saw Hou Zi coming out and said, "Let's go to the scene first."

Next to the locust tree forest outside Fangshi, Zhang Mazi's body was there, surrounded by many people, all casual cultivators from the slums.Lao Huaitou was also there. He smiled and said hello to Hou Zi.

Hou Zi leaned over and asked, "Master, are you so free today?"

"Watching the fun, who doesn't like it?" Old Huaitou said, pointing at Zhang Mazi, "Look at this Mazi, who dominates the slums every day. So many bullied people want him to die, but absolutely no one dares to actually take action." He glanced at Lei Peng.

There was nothing unusual about Zhang Mazi's body. His pubic area was destroyed and his hamstrings were picked, all signs of death. There was no sign of blackening or poisoning.

Lei Peng said to Hou Zi: "Master Ma, you can't see anything here. Why don't we go to the place where Zhang Mazi is imprisoned and take a look."

"Okay." Hou Zi didn't say much.

The place where Zhang Mazi was imprisoned was an old warehouse owned by the Dongcheng Gang on the edge of the slums. Lao Cui used to use it to pile up the scraps of the refining equipment, and later the Dongcheng Gang requisitioned it as a solitary room.There is only one iron door in the warehouse, and there are several ventilation openings high up, which are hastily sealed with bricks. A finger can be inserted into the gaps between the bricks.There was a thin guard standing outside the door, his face was pale and his lips were trembling. When he saw Lei Peng approaching, his legs went weak and he almost knelt down.

"Master Lei... I really don't know what's going on... The door was locked perfectly last night, so I sat at the door and never left. At dawn, I opened the door to deliver food to Zhang Mazi, but it was empty! No one was there! The door lock is still in good condition!"

Lei Peng didn't scold him or look at him. He just walked to the iron door, reached out and touched the copper lock.The lock is in good condition with no signs of being picked.He looked down at the iron bolts on the door frame, and there was no damage.The guard sat at the door all night.The person disappeared out of thin air, and then died in the woods outside Fangshi.
